prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1190; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force and direction of the collision. Over the course of ten visits, care included passive and active range-of-motion exercises, progressive strengthening, and manual therapy. Treatment continued somewhat longer than is typical for this presentation, reflecting a slower functional recovery. On examination, pain with resisted abduction and a reduced arc of motion support the diagnosis of a soft tissue injury to the shoulder, while neurovascular screening and several orthopedic special tests were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment to this body region, and no earlier records addressing the shoulder were available for review. Billing records reflect a single charge for each service rendered, with no duplicate entries. At the most recent visit, the patient demonstrated improved strength and motion but had not yet returned fully to prior activity levels. Continued home exercise and periodic reassessment are recommended.
